---
title: R-1 fitted the mean absolute error, not the RMS error
description: The protocol's measure is the RMS error; R-1 fitted the slope to the mean absolute error by mistake.
genre: journal
date: 2026-10-04
kind: correction
about: [R-1, pi-error-scaling]
---

The fold was run with --error mae when the protocol names the RMS error. R-2 records the RMS slope from the same evidence and supersedes R-1. Both commands still re-derive their own numbers.
